calibration_analysis.mathematical_justification: Context-as-Leverage scales all pillars around par = 50.0: Adjusted = clip(50 + (Raw - 50) * L, 0.1, 99.9). If P3 neutral par were shifted to 60 or 65, any leverage multiplier L != 1.0 would systematically distort the score because the fulcrum of leverage would no longer align with zero surplus. Raw P3 = Mean (0.159) maps exactly to 50.0.

neutral_team_state_impact.condition: Team trajectory essentially flat (delta EFS ~ 0.0, delta RRR ~ 0.0).

successful_state_maintenance.condition: Elite platform (EFS >= 180 or RRR <= 7.5) preserved at high tempo (Phase 7Q floor = 64.0).

positive_transformation.condition: Massive positive shift in projected score (delta EFS >= +15) or rapid liquidation of chase.

negative_deterioration.condition: Team collapse, severe dot-ball accumulation, or rising RRR blowout.

final_decision_gate.decision: A. P3 architecture is validated and ready for freeze.
final_decision_gate.recommendation_summary: The combined Phase 7O (Early-Over Sample-Size Stabilization) and Phase 7U (Model T Wicket Causality Attribution) architecture is mathematically sound, empirically robust, completely free of leakages, and produces cricket-wise coherent scores across all 19,111 historical appearances. No further formula modification is required.
